# `admin.attest.verify`

Verify attestations for one subject

Site admins only. Lists the daemon attestations for a commit subject and reports how many are live.

- Method and path: `GET /admin/attestations/verify`
- Scope: `admin:write`
- Kind: `read`
- CLI: `rukie admin attest verify`
- MCP: `admin_attest_verify`
- ETag: served; send it back as If-Match to write safely

## Inputs

| Name | In | Required | Type |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `owner` | query | no | `string` |
| `repo` | query | no | `string` |
| `subject` | query | no | `string` |

## Errors

`forbidden`, `invalid`, `not-found`, `unavailable`, `validation`, plus the framework problems.
